notes.title: 🚀Devil Engine: Complete Edition
notes.content:
Hello Pilots,

After what feels like an eternity of anticipation, we are thrilled to announce that Devil Engine: Complete Edition has officially arrived on Steam! Get ready to dive into a world of explosive action, breathtaking visuals, and adrenaline-pumping gameplay.

[h2]✨ What's in Store for You:[/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36381/Devil_Engine_Complete_Edition/]Devil Engine: Complete Edition[/url] takes the intensity of the original game to a whole new level. Brace yourselves for an onslaught of challenging enemies, epic boss battles, and a symphony of bullets that will test your skills to the max.

[h3]🚀New Features, New Thrills: [/h3]
We've cranked up the excitement with brand-new features, including additional game modes, upgraded visuals, and an enhanced soundtrack that will immerse you even deeper into the Devil Engine universe.

[b]🎮 Steam Deck Ready:[/b]  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36381/Devil_Engine_Complete_Edition/]Devil Engine: Complete Edition[/url] has undergone rigorous testing on the Steam Deck, an optimized gaming experience on this groundbreaking handheld device.

[b]🌐 Global Leaderboards: [/b]
Think you're the ultimate Devil Engine pilot? Prove it on the global leaderboards. Compete with players from around the world and climb to the top ranks. Glory awaits the bravest!

[h3]The Moment You've Been Waiting For:[/h3]
The journey has been long, and your patience has been truly appreciated.  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36381/Devil_Engine_Complete_Edition/]Devil Engine: Complete Edition[/url] is finally yours to enjoy. Thank you for being part of this incredible adventure with us.
[previewyoutube=4zX7j6xGCZE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]🎶 A Celebration to Remember: [/b]
To celebrate this momentous occasion, we've got some surprises in store for you. Keep an eye out for limited-time promotions and special videos and music to be released throughout the rest of the year! Immerse yourself in the heart-pounding beats of the Devil Engine soundtrack. 

[b]🖼️ Steam Gallery: [/b]
Visit the Steam page for Devil Engine and head to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/891790/images/]"Community" tab to explore the gallery.[/url]

[b]🔥 Ready to Scotch the Earth? [/b]
Get [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36381/Devil_Engine_Complete_Edition/]Devil Engine: Complete Edition[/url] on Steam now!

Thank you for your unwavering support and for joining us on this journey. May your flights be swift, your shots true, and your victories legendary! See you on the [b]leaderboards[/b]!

Warm regards,

~Poppy Works

notes.title: Devil Engine thunders forcefully into stores with demo
notes.content:
I’ve always had an easier time playing ‘bullet hell’ shooters than more old-school ones like Devil Engine, which launched today. Enemies in those old shmups were positively ornery in their aggression, constantly pressuring the player with unpredictable mix-up attacks. Among the best of that late 16-bit era of shooting was Technosoft’s Thunder Force series. Protoculture Games’s debut feels like a proud tribute to those twitchy gems, complete with an intentionally limited colour palette, but a few ideas of its own. See the trailer below or snag a demo on Steam here.

(more…)

notes.title: Devil Engine will release Febuary 21st!
notes.content:
Been a bit of a long 2018 winter hasn't it?

Devil Engine will finally be launching later this month, on the 21st!
Leading up to release we'll be showing off some more footage and development tidbits on Twitter, [url=https://twitter.com/Protocultgames]so check us out over there.[/url]

notes.title: Demo coming this Friday!
notes.content:
Hope you're ready for another taste of the devil;  A new demo is approaching!

This time, it's based off the Tokyo Game Show 2018 build, but with some improvements added since the event.  Of course, it's a lot more polished than the previous demo, which is over a year old.

Among several balance and mechanical tweaks, the biggest addition is online leaderboard support. Compete for score across the whole world! Who will come out on top?

Once the demo hits we'll be running a score contest to win full game keys and other prizes. Look forward to that in the coming days. An FAQ will be available in the discussions as well.
